integrity: All results are self-contained exact finite-dimensional algebra and calculus; standalone Python tests are supplementary. Literature coverage was checked against accessible primary texts and abstracts; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two equal-noise landmarks on the normalized uniform circle, rank-three kernel \(k_a(x,y)=a+\cos(x-y)\) with \(a>0\), fixed regularization \(t>0\); no optimality for larger designs, arbitrary kernels, or posterior-data-dependent selection. The exact zero-noise collision is interpreted using the Moore–Penrose inverse and is discontinuous. Earlier specialized publication overlap is not excluded.
title: Exact two-landmark design for a cosine kernel: a noise-independent angle and a quarter-power collision law
